info.name: QueueSense Weekly Waiting Time
info.description: Set the Choreo invocation base URL and approved department. Provide a short-lived OAuth token in a private Postman environment.

request.description: Supply the approved department and the Monday of a completed clinic week. Dates follow Asia/Colombo clinic time. Results are in minutes. Metrics are null when fewer than ten waits were measured. Responses generated by the gateway may differ from QueueSense origin responses.

query.description: Department UUID assigned to the approved proxy.
Monday of a completed clinic week, formatted YYYY-MM-DD.
